name: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric

intro: You work closely with analytics engineers, architects, analysts, and administrators to design and deploy data engineering solutions for analytics.
You should be skilled at manipulating and transforming data by using Structured Query Language (SQL), PySpark, and Kusto Query Language (KQL).

lists.lead: As a candidate for this exam, you should have subject matter expertise with data loading patterns, data architectures, and orchestration processes. Your responsibilities for this role include

items.text: Securing and managing an analytics solution.
Monitoring and optimizing an analytics solution.
